name: Zaizenji Kazue
source:
Kirino's mother and Rin's grandmother. President of the School Board.
Gentle and mild-mannered, but also strict when necessary.
Works to support Kirino, and is also the advisor for the flower arrangement club.
Holds her family and the school they've inherited for generations very dearly.
